# Public handwriting test fixtures

100 images selected deterministically from the official MNIST **test** split: the first ten examples of each label 0–9. These were not used to train or adapt the model in this project. The gzip JSON also contains ONNX Runtime reference logits for numerical parity checks.

MNIST copyright: Yann LeCun and Corinna Cortes; derived from NIST handwriting datasets. License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 (CC BY-SA 3.0), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/ . Attribution and license apply to the embedded image data and adapted fixture file.

Dataset source: https://storage.googleapis.com/tensorflow/tf-keras-datasets/mnist.npz
Dataset SHA256: `731c5ac602752760c8e48fbffcf8c3b850d9dc2a2aedcf2cc48468fc17b673d1`.
Dataset metadata/license: https://github.com/keras-team/keras/blob/master/keras/src/datasets/mnist.py

No employee handwriting, attendance records, payroll or other private data is included.
